study.name: CPTC original-native 8-arm serve study, accepted 20261120
study.design: ABBA per MTP block, order A1 C1 C2 A2; 2 boots per variant
study.warmup_rule: output lengths 513/1025/2049 and 2 are excluded warmups; only 512/1024/2048 and 1 are measured

prior_a1_review.scope: Parent review of completed baseline A1 after correcting compact-PCI thermal parsing. No GPU rerun, no mutation of original receipts or benchmark artifacts.

study.boot_validity_note: Accepted join covers seven completed continuation boots plus the independently reviewed prior A1; no faults, KFD, or thermal failures are reported in the accepted receipts. The original failed gate receipt remains unchanged.

config_provenance.scope_note: Only the checked fields above were compared; no claim is made that every runtime argument is identical.

aggregate_output_tok_s.source: bench JSON total_output_tokens, duration; equals bench output_throughput

aggregate_input_tok_s.source: bench JSON total_input_tokens, duration; primary prefill aggregate metric

per_request_decode_tok_s.source: bench JSON per-request output_lens, latencies (s), ttfts (s)
per_request_decode_tok_s.note: Excludes TTFT and the first output token; decoded interval is latency minus TTFT. Not aggregate/c. Per-request value averaged arithmetically across requests in the cell (equal request weight).

decoded_interval_ms.note: Wall interval carrying output tokens 2..N of request j, including any batch waiting/preemption.

start_offset_s.source: bench JSON start_times (per-request client launch timestamps)
start_offset_s.note: Launch offset relative to the first request in the cell, not a queue wait. At c8 it is <=0.011 s in every measured cell; at c1 the four prompts are launched sequentially by design.

queue_time_raw_s.note: Observed to track start_times[j]-min(start_times): it is a launch/queue timestamp offset in this harness, not a measured wait duration. Do not compare it to evicted_before_workers or evicted_ms evidence.

ttft_mean_ms.source: bench JSON mean_ttft_ms (arithmetic mean of client-observed per-request TTFT)
ttft_mean_ms.note: Client-observed send-to-first-token; includes HTTP/stream/transport, admission, scheduling, and, at c8, concurrent batching/contention. Not pure GPU prefill kernel time.

itl_median_ms.source: bench JSON median_itl_ms, pooled over all recorded itls arrays
itl_median_ms.note: The harness records one ITL per streamed step. At MTP0 a step is usually one token; at MTP2 a step emits roughly 3 tokens. Cross-MTP ITL medians are therefore not token-normalized and are not directly comparable. Use TPOT or per-request decode tok/s for per-token comparisons.

itl_p99_ms.source: bench JSON p99_itl_ms, pooled over all recorded itls arrays
itl_p99_ms.note: Same per-step caveat as itl_median_ms. Long stalls/preemptions inflate p99.

tpot_mean_ms.units: milliseconds per output token after the first
tpot_mean_ms.source: bench JSON mean_tpot_ms; cross-checked equal to mean over requests of 1000*(latency-ttft)/(output_len-1)
tpot_mean_ms.note: Present in this harness. Token-normalized, unlike per-step ITL.

tpot_median_ms.units: milliseconds per output token after the first
tpot_median_ms.source: bench JSON median_tpot_ms; median across per-request average TPOT values

tpot_p99_ms.units: milliseconds per output token after the first
tpot_p99_ms.source: bench JSON p99_tpot_ms; p99 across per-request average TPOT values (request-level distribution, not per-token p99)

per_request_effective_prompt_tok_s.note: Prefill-only output_len=1 cells. Effective client-observed rate, including transport/admission/scheduling and c8 contention; not a pure prefill kernel rate. TTFT includes the single output token, so the rate slightly understates pure prompt-processing throughput. Mean/median across requests.

delta_pct_of_baseline_mean.note: Positive delta = higher metric. For TTFT/ITL/TPOT lower is better, so a positive delta is a regression.

pairwise_delta_pct_range_descriptive.formula: min/max over the four C_boot vs A_boot pairs of 100*(C-A)/A
pairwise_delta_pct_range_descriptive.note: Descriptive boot-to-boot spread only. Two boots per arm cannot support a confidence interval or significance claim.

limitations: Two boots per variant (ABBA); reported ranges are descriptive min/max, not confidence intervals, standard errors, or significance tests.
No population or repeatability claim beyond these eight boots.
Client-observed TTFT and ITL include harness/HTTP/transport overhead; c8 TTFT additionally includes server batching and contention.

ITL is recorded per streamed step, not per token. MTP2 emits multiple tokens per step, so raw ITL medians/p99 are not comparable across MTP0 and MTP2. TPOT and derived per-request decode tok/s are token-normalized.
Generation aggregate output tok/s includes prompt prefill and scheduling in the wall window; per-request decode tok/s isolates the post-first-token interval.
Prefill-only cells have output_len=1; decode, ITL, and TPOT are omitted because there is no decoded interval.

Absolute results are specific to runtime df548843ebca6f45149b505fb51367aded85c0ee and library af0f5d6194b4fdd10b787598e8dc4802735999f99f96cf9485e53cfd5d6e49d1, TP2, HIP0/1 d1/d4, FP16, 16 GiB KV per rank, maxlen 262144, seqs 8.
No optimized-kernel or ablation combination is analyzed here; no performance claims are made for unrun optimizations.
No model accuracy claims; PPL is not used in this summary.
